summary: @or-sdk/source-api ships obfuscated install-time payload executed via downloaded Bun runtime
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip`, marks it executable, and invokes it against a locally-shipped file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB heavily-obfuscated JavaScript file (hex-named identifiers, a large numeric string-array with a rotator and string-decoder function) that is not referenced by the package's declared library entry (`main`) and has no corresponding source or documentation. The package's advertised purpose is a REST source-API client, which does not require a separate JavaScript runtime or an obfuscated binary-shaped payload. Executing an opaque, author-controlled payload under a freshly-fetched alien runtime at `npm install` time bypasses Node-based inspection and constitutes arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine on default install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
